title.fa: کلمه‌های تضاد میان دو جمله
title.en: Contrast linkers between two sentences
title.tr: Kalame-haye tazad miyan-e do jomle

summary.fa: جملهٔ دوم «ولی» می‌گوید: خوب است، اما…
summary.en: The second sentence says "but": it is good, however…
summary.tr: Jomle-ye dovvom "vali" miguyad: khoob ast, amma…

title.fa: اول بفهم: چراغ راهنمای پیچ
title.en: Understand first: the turn indicator
title.tr: Avval befahm: cheragh-e rahnama-ye pich

body.fa: کلمه‌های تضاد مثل چراغ راهنمای ماشین‌اند که پیش از پیچیدن روشن می‌شود: به خواننده خبر می‌دهند که جملهٔ بعد مسیر را برمی‌گرداند. `Solar power is expensive to install; however, it saves money in the long run.` جملهٔ اول یک طرف ماجراست (گران است) و جملهٔ دوم طرف مقابل (پول را پس می‌آورد). `however`، `nevertheless`، `on the other hand` و `yet` همه همین کار را می‌کنند.
body.en: Contrast linkers are like a car's indicator that comes on before a turn: they warn the reader that the next sentence changes direction. `Solar power is expensive to install; however, it saves money in the long run.` The first sentence is one side of the story (it is expensive) and the second the other side (it pays the money back). `however`, `nevertheless`, `on the other hand` and `yet` all do this job.
body.tr: Kalame-haye tazad mesl-e cheragh-e rahnama-ye mashin-and ke pish az pichidan roshan mishavad: be khanande khabar midahand ke jomle-ye ba'd masir ra barmigardanad. `Solar power is expensive to install; however, it saves money in the long run.` Jomle-ye avval yek taraf-e majarast (geran ast) va jomle-ye dovvom taraf-e moghabel (pool ra pas miavarad). `however`, `nevertheless`, `on the other hand` va `yet` hame hamin kar ra mikonand.

caption.fa: دو جملهٔ کامل، با نقطه‌ویرگول پیش از کلمهٔ تضاد و ویرگول بعد از آن.
caption.en: Two complete sentences, with a semicolon before the linker and a comma after it.
caption.tr: Do jomle-ye kamel, ba noghte-virgool pish az kalame-ye tazad va virgool ba'd az an.

title.fa: خلاف یا نتیجه؟
title.en: Against, or a result?
title.tr: Khalaf ya natije?

body.fa: برای انتخاب درست، فقط بپرس: آیا جملهٔ دوم «برخلاف» جملهٔ اول است؟ اگر بله، کلمهٔ تضاد. `Dams produce a lot of electricity; however, they change river habitats.` (یک خوبی، یک بدی.) اگر جملهٔ دوم «نتیجهٔ» جملهٔ اول باشد، کلمهٔ تضاد غلط است و `therefore` لازم است (واحد سوم). `nevertheless` رسمی‌تر از `however` است و `on the other hand` دو طرف یک مقایسه را نشان می‌دهد.
body.en: To choose correctly, just ask: is the second sentence "against" the first one? If yes, a contrast linker. `Dams produce a lot of electricity; however, they change river habitats.` (One good point, one bad point.) If the second sentence is the "result" of the first, a contrast linker is wrong and you need `therefore` (Unit 3). `nevertheless` is more formal than `however`, and `on the other hand` shows the two sides of a comparison.
body.tr: Baraye entekhab-e dorost, faghat bepors: aya jomle-ye dovvom "barkhalaf"-e jomle-ye avval ast? Agar bale, kalame-ye tazad. `Dams produce a lot of electricity; however, they change river habitats.` (Yek khoobi, yek badi.) Agar jomle-ye dovvom "natije"-ye jomle-ye avval bashad, kalame-ye tazad ghalat ast va `therefore` lazem ast (vahed-e sevvom). `nevertheless` rasmi-tar az `however` ast va `on the other hand` do taraf-e yek moghayese ra neshan midahad.

caption.en: Between two complete sentences that contrast
caption.tr: Miyan-e do jomle-ye kamel ke ba ham dar tazad-and

title.fa: گرم کردن: کلمهٔ تضاد را بنویس: `Solar power is expensive to install initially; ___, it saves a lot of money in the long run.` (آزمون دی ۱۴۰۰)
title.en: Warm-up: write the contrast linker: `Solar power is expensive to install initially; ___, it saves a lot of money in the long run.` (Dey 1400 paper)
title.tr: Garm kardan: kalame-ye tazad ra benevis: `Solar power is expensive to install initially; ___, it saves a lot of money in the long run.` (azmoon-e Dey 1400)

text.fa: اول: گران؛ دوم: صرفه‌جویی. جملهٔ دوم خلاف اول است و جای خالی بین `;` و `,` نشسته.
text.en: First: expensive; second: saves money. The second sentence goes against the first, and the gap sits between `;` and `,`.
text.tr: Avval: geran; dovvom: sarfe-jooyi. Jomle-ye dovvom khalaf-e avval ast va ja-ye khali beyn-e `;` va `,` neshaste.

title.fa: مسئلهٔ کتاب و امتحان: کلمهٔ تضاد را بنویس: `Renewable energy systems are friendly to nature; ___, their installation costs are currently high.` (آزمون دی ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Textbook and exam: write the contrast linker: `Renewable energy systems are friendly to nature; ___, their installation costs are currently high.` (Dey 1401 paper)
title.tr: Mas'ale-ye ketab va emtehan: kalame-ye tazad ra benevis: `Renewable energy systems are friendly to nature; ___, their installation costs are currently high.` (azmoon-e Dey 1401)

text.fa: دو طرف یک ترازو: طرف خوب (دوستدار طبیعت) و طرف بد (هزینهٔ بالا).
text.en: Two sides of a scale: the good side (friendly to nature) and the bad side (high cost).
text.tr: Do taraf-e yek tarazoo: taraf-e khoob (doostdar-e tabi'at) va taraf-e bad (hazine-ye bala).

text.fa: در گزینه‌های این سؤال، عبارتِ سه‌کلمه‌ای که دقیقاً «طرف دیگر» را می‌گوید جواب است.
text.en: Among this question's options, the three-word phrase that literally says "the other side" is the answer.
text.tr: Dar gozine-haye in so'al, ebarat-e se-kalame-i ke daghighan "taraf-e digar" ra miguyad javab ast.

title.fa: پیچ امتحانی: کلمهٔ درست را بنویس: `Fossil fuels cause severe air pollution; ___, they are still used in many old factories.` (آزمون دی ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Exam twist: write the right word: `Fossil fuels cause severe air pollution; ___, they are still used in many old factories.` (Dey 1401 paper)
title.tr: Pich-e emtehani: kalame-ye dorost ra benevis: `Fossil fuels cause severe air pollution; ___, they are still used in many old factories.` (azmoon-e Dey 1401)

text.fa: پیچ امتحان: `still` (هنوز) نشانهٔ تعجب است: با همهٔ آلودگی، هنوز استفاده می‌شوند. پس تضاد، نه نتیجه.
text.en: The twist: `still` signals surprise: despite all the pollution, they are still used. So contrast, not a result.
text.tr: Pich-e emtehan: `still` (hanooz) neshane-ye ta'ajjob ast: ba hame-ye aloodegi, hanooz estefade mishavand. Pas tazad, na natije.

text.fa: جواب این سؤال کلمهٔ کوتاه سه‌حرفی تضاد است که مثل `however` کار می‌کند.
text.en: The answer here is the short three-letter contrast word that works like `however`.
text.tr: Javab-e in so'al kalame-ye kootah-e se-harfi-ye tazad ast ke mesl-e `however` kar mikonad.

body.fa: `however` را با `therefore` عوض نکن: اگر جملهٔ دوم خلاف اول است، `therefore` نمره نمی‌گیرد.
body.en: Do not swap `however` for `therefore`: if the second sentence goes against the first, `therefore` earns nothing.
body.tr: `however` ra ba `therefore` avaz nakon: agar jomle-ye dovvom khalaf-e avval ast, `therefore` nomre nemigirad.

body.fa: `however` دو جملهٔ کامل را جدا می‌کند؛ آن را مثل `but` وسط یک جمله با ویرگول تنها نگذار.
body.en: `however` separates two complete sentences; do not drop it mid-sentence with just a comma, as if it were `but`.
body.tr: `however` do jomle-ye kamel ra joda mikonad; an ra mesl-e `but` vasat-e yek jomle ba virgool-e tanha nagozar.

title.fa: تضاد درون یک جمله
title.en: Contrast inside one sentence
title.tr: Tazad daroon-e yek jomle

summary.fa: دو تصویر کنار هم در یک قاب: این یکی تمیز است، در حالی که آن یکی آلوده.
summary.en: Two pictures side by side in one frame: this one is clean, whereas that one pollutes.
summary.tr: Do tasvir kenar-e ham dar yek ghab: in yeki tamiz ast, dar hali ke an yeki aloode.

title.fa: اول بفهم: دو تصویر در یک قاب
title.en: Understand first: two pictures in one frame
title.tr: Avval befahm: do tasvir dar yek ghab

body.fa: `while` و `whereas` دو تصویر را در یک قاب کنار هم می‌گذارند تا تفاوتشان دیده شود: «در حالی که». فرقشان با `however` در ساختار است: `however` میان دو جملهٔ جدا می‌آید (با `;`)، ولی `while` و `whereas` دو بخش را در «یک» جمله به هم می‌دوزند، معمولاً با یک ویرگول: `Wind energy is clean, whereas fossil fuels pollute the environment.`
body.en: `while` and `whereas` put two pictures side by side in one frame so their difference shows. The difference from `however` is in the structure: `however` comes between two separate sentences (with `;`), but `while` and `whereas` stitch two parts into "one" sentence, usually with a comma: `Wind energy is clean, whereas fossil fuels pollute the environment.`
body.tr: `while` va `whereas` do tasvir ra dar yek ghab kenar-e ham migozarand ta tafavotashan dide shavad: "dar hali ke". Farghashan ba `however` dar sakhtar ast: `however` miyan-e do jomle-ye joda miayad (ba `;`), vali `while` va `whereas` do bakhsh ra dar "yek" jomle be ham midoozand, ma'moolan ba yek virgool: `Wind energy is clean, whereas fossil fuels pollute the environment.`

caption.fa: `while` و `whereas` درون یک جمله با ویرگول؛ `however` میان دو جمله با نقطه‌ویرگول.
caption.en: `while` and `whereas` inside one sentence with a comma; `however` between two sentences with a semicolon.
caption.tr: `while` va `whereas` daroon-e yek jomle ba virgool; `however` miyan-e do jomle ba noghte-virgool.

title.fa: نشانه‌گذاری سرنخ است
title.en: Punctuation is the clue
title.tr: Neshane-gozari sarnakh ast

body.fa: نشانه‌گذاری بهترین سرنخ است: اگر پیش از جای خالی ویرگول است و بعدش ویرگول نیست، کلمه‌ای از نوع `while` یا `whereas` لازم است. اگر پیش از جای خالی `;` و بعدش `,` است، کلمه‌ای از نوع `however`. `while` معنای «در حین» هم دارد، ولی در تضاد یعنی «در حالی که».
body.en: Punctuation is the best clue: if there is a comma before the gap and none after it, you need a word like `while` or `whereas`. If there is `;` before the gap and `,` after it, a word like `however`. `while` can also mean "during the time that", but in a contrast it means "whereas".
body.tr: Neshane-gozari behtarin sarnakh ast: agar pish az ja-ye khali virgool ast va ba'dash virgool nist, kalame-i az no'-e `while` ya `whereas` lazem ast. Agar pish az ja-ye khali `;` va ba'dash `,` ast, kalame-i az no'-e `however`. `while` ma'na-ye "dar heyn" ham darad, vali dar tazad ya'ni "dar hali ke".

caption.en: Two contrasting parts in one sentence
caption.tr: Do bakhsh-e motazad dar yek jomle

title.fa: گرم کردن: کلمهٔ تضاد را بنویس: `Wind energy is clean and unlimited, ___ fossil fuels pollute the environment and are finite.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Warm-up: write the contrast linker: `Wind energy is clean and unlimited, ___ fossil fuels pollute the environment and are finite.` (Khordad 1401 paper)
title.tr: Garm kardan: kalame-ye tazad ra benevis: `Wind energy is clean and unlimited, ___ fossil fuels pollute the environment and are finite.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1401)

text.fa: دو تصویر متضاد (تمیز و نامحدود / آلوده و محدود) در یک جمله، با ویرگول پیش از جای خالی و بدون ویرگول بعد از آن.
text.en: Two opposite pictures (clean and unlimited / polluting and finite) in one sentence, with a comma before the gap and none after it.
text.tr: Do tasvir-e motazad (tamiz va namahdood / aloode va mahdood) dar yek jomle, ba virgool pish az ja-ye khali va bedoon-e virgool ba'd az an.

title.fa: مسئلهٔ کتاب و امتحان: کلمهٔ تضاد را بنویس: `Some people prefer fossil fuels, ___ others advocate for solar energy.` (آزمون دی ۱۳۹۹)
title.en: Textbook and exam: write the contrast linker: `Some people prefer fossil fuels, ___ others advocate for solar energy.` (Dey 1399 paper)
title.tr: Mas'ale-ye ketab va emtehan: kalame-ye tazad ra benevis: `Some people prefer fossil fuels, ___ others advocate for solar energy.` (azmoon-e Dey 1399)

text.fa: `Some ...` و `others ...` دو گروه مقابل هم‌اند، در یک جمله.
text.en: `Some ...` and `others ...` are two opposing groups, in one sentence.
text.tr: `Some ...` va `others ...` do goroh-e moghabel-e ham-and, dar yek jomle.

text.fa: ویرگول پیش از جای خالی و بی‌ویرگول بعدش؛ جواب این سؤال `while` است.
text.en: A comma before the gap and none after; the answer here is `while`.
text.tr: Virgool pish az ja-ye khali va bi-virgool ba'dash; javab-e in so'al `while` ast.

title.fa: پیچ امتحانی: کدام درست است؟ `Solar panels are clean, ___ coal is dirty.` الف) `however` ب) `whereas`
title.en: Exam twist: which is correct? `Solar panels are clean, ___ coal is dirty.` a) `however` b) `whereas`
title.tr: Pich-e emtehani: kodam dorost ast? `Solar panels are clean, ___ coal is dirty.` alef) `however` be) `whereas`

text.fa: پیچ امتحان: معنای هر دو تضاد است، پس معنا کمکی نمی‌کند؛ ساختار تصمیم می‌گیرد.
text.en: The twist: both mean contrast, so meaning does not help; the structure decides.
text.tr: Pich-e emtehan: ma'na-ye har do tazad ast, pas ma'na komaki nemikonad; sakhtar tasmim migirad.

text.fa: پیش از جای خالی ویرگول است و جمله یکی است؛ `however` با ویرگول تنها درست نیست.
text.en: There is a comma before the gap and it is one sentence; `however` with just a comma is not correct.
text.tr: Pish az ja-ye khali virgool ast va jomle yeki ast; `however` ba virgool-e tanha dorost nist.

body.fa: `whereas` و `while` را پس از نقطه‌ویرگول نگذار؛ آن‌ها دو بخش «یک» جمله را وصل می‌کنند.
body.en: Do not put `whereas` or `while` after a semicolon; they join two parts of "one" sentence.
body.tr: `whereas` va `while` ra pas az noghte-virgool nagozar; an-ha do bakhsh-e "yek" jomle ra vasl mikonand.

body.fa: معنای «در حین» `while` را با تضاد قاطی نکن: در `Some like X, while others like Y` معنا «در حالی که» است.
body.en: Do not mix up the "during" meaning of `while` with contrast: in `Some like X, while others like Y` it means "whereas".
body.tr: Ma'na-ye "dar heyn"-e `while` ra ba tazad ghati nakon: dar `Some like X, while others like Y` ma'na "dar hali ke" ast.

title.fa: علت و نتیجه
title.en: Cause and effect
title.tr: Ellat va natije

summary.fa: دومینو: اولی که بیفتد، دومی هم می‌افتد.
summary.en: Dominoes: when the first falls, the second falls too.
summary.tr: Domino: avvali ke biyoftad, dovvomi ham mioftad.

title.fa: اول بفهم: دومینو
title.en: Understand first: the dominoes
title.tr: Avval befahm: domino

body.fa: `therefore` مثل دومینوست: جملهٔ اول علت است و جملهٔ دوم نتیجه‌ای که از آن می‌افتد: «بنابراین». `Fossil fuels are running out; therefore, we need renewable energy.` تمام شدنِ سوخت (علت) باعث نیاز به انرژی نو (نتیجه) می‌شود. ساختارش مثل `however` است (`;` پیش از آن و `,` بعد از آن)، ولی معنایش برعکس: `however` مسیر را برمی‌گرداند، `therefore` مسیر را ادامه می‌دهد.
body.en: `therefore` is like a line of dominoes: the first sentence is the cause and the second the result that falls from it. `Fossil fuels are running out; therefore, we need renewable energy.` Fuel running out (the cause) creates the need for new energy (the result). Its structure is like `however` (`;` before it and `,` after it), but its meaning is the opposite: `however` turns the road, `therefore` keeps going straight.
body.tr: `therefore` mesl-e domino-st: jomle-ye avval ellat ast va jomle-ye dovvom natije-i ke az an mioftad: "banabarin". `Fossil fuels are running out; therefore, we need renewable energy.` Tamam shodan-e sookht (ellat) ba'es-e niaz be enerzhi-ye no (natije) mishavad. Sakhtarash mesl-e `however` ast (`;` pish az an va `,` ba'd az an), vali ma'nayash bar-aks: `however` masir ra barmigardanad, `therefore` masir ra edame midahad.

blocks.art:
cause ; therefore , result
   -->               -->
   same direction (so)

 fact  ; however ,   surprise
   -->               <--

caption.fa: `therefore` ادامهٔ مسیر است (علت به نتیجه)؛ `however` برگشت مسیر (خلاف انتظار).
caption.en: `therefore` continues the road (cause to result); `however` turns it (against expectation).
caption.tr: `therefore` edame-ye masir ast (ellat be natije); `however` bargasht-e masir (khalaf-e entezar).

title.fa: آزمون «پس» یا «ولی»
title.en: The "so" or "but" test
title.tr: Azmoon-e "pas" ya "vali"

body.fa: آزمون سادهٔ «پس»: جای خالی را با «پس» فارسی بخوان. اگر جمله معنا داشت، `therefore` درست است: «سوخت‌های فسیلی تمام می‌شوند؛ پس باید به انرژی‌های نو توجه کنیم.» اگر با «ولی» معنا داشت، کلمهٔ تضاد لازم است.
body.en: The simple "so" test: read the gap as "so". If the sentence makes sense, `therefore` is right: "fossil fuels are running out; so we must focus on renewable energy." If it makes sense with "but", you need a contrast linker.
body.tr: Azmoon-e sade-ye "pas": ja-ye khali ra ba "pas"-e farsi bekhan. Agar jomle ma'na dasht, `therefore` dorost ast: "sookht-haye fosili tamam mishavand; pas bayad be enerzhi-haye no tavajjoh konim." Agar ba "vali" ma'na dasht, kalame-ye tazad lazem ast.

caption.fa: بنابراین: نتیجه از علت پیروی می‌کند
caption.en: Therefore: the result follows from the cause
caption.tr: Banabarin: natije az ellat peyravi mikonad

title.fa: گرم کردن: کلمهٔ ربط را بنویس: `Fossil fuels are running out; ___, we need to focus more on renewable energy sources.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۴۰۰)
title.en: Warm-up: write the linker: `Fossil fuels are running out; ___, we need to focus more on renewable energy sources.` (Khordad 1400 paper)
title.tr: Garm kardan: kalame-ye rabt ra benevis: `Fossil fuels are running out; ___, we need to focus more on renewable energy sources.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1400)

text.fa: آزمون «پس»: «سوخت تمام می‌شود؛ پس باید به انرژی نو توجه کنیم.» معنا دارد.
text.en: The "so" test: "fuel is running out; so we must focus on new energy." It makes sense.
text.tr: Azmoon-e "pas": "sookht tamam mishavad; pas bayad be enerzhi-ye no tavajjoh konim." Ma'na darad.

title.fa: مسئلهٔ کتاب و امتحان: کلمهٔ ربط علت و نتیجه را بنویس: `Fossil fuels are limited and cause heavy pollution; ___, solar and wind energy are getting more popular.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۳۹۹)
title.en: Textbook and exam: write the cause-and-effect linker: `Fossil fuels are limited and cause heavy pollution; ___, solar and wind energy are getting more popular.` (Khordad 1399 paper)
title.tr: Mas'ale-ye ketab va emtehan: kalame-ye rabt-e ellat va natije ra benevis: `Fossil fuels are limited and cause heavy pollution; ___, solar and wind energy are getting more popular.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1399)

text.fa: علت: محدود و آلاینده. نتیجه: محبوب‌تر شدن انرژی پاک. همان دومینو.
text.en: Cause: limited and polluting. Result: clean energy getting more popular. The same dominoes.
text.tr: Ellat: mahdood va alayande. Natije: mahboob-tar shodan-e enerzhi-ye pak. Haman domino.

title.fa: پیچ امتحانی: کدام درست است؟ `Fossil fuels damage our environment; ___, we must invest heavily in solar infrastructure.` الف) `however` ب) `therefore` (آزمون دی ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Exam twist: which is correct? `Fossil fuels damage our environment; ___, we must invest heavily in solar infrastructure.` a) `however` b) `therefore` (Dey 1401 paper)
title.tr: Pich-e emtehani: kodam dorost ast? `Fossil fuels damage our environment; ___, we must invest heavily in solar infrastructure.` alef) `however` be) `therefore` (azmoon-e Dey 1401)

text.fa: پیچ امتحان: نشانه‌گذاری برای هر دو یکی است (`;` و `,`)، پس فقط معنا تصمیم می‌گیرد.
text.en: The twist: the punctuation is the same for both (`;` and `,`), so only meaning decides.
text.tr: Pich-e emtehan: neshane-gozari baraye har do yeki ast (`;` va `,`), pas faghat ma'na tasmim migirad.

text.fa: «آسیب می‌زنند؛ پس باید سرمایه‌گذاری کنیم» معنا دارد، «ولی» ندارد.
text.en: "They damage it; so we must invest" makes sense, "but" does not.
text.tr: "Asib mizanand; pas bayad sarmaye-gozari konim" ma'na darad, "vali" nadarad.

body.fa: شکل نشانه‌گذاری `therefore` و `however` یکی است؛ فقط با معنا انتخاب کن، نه با ظاهر جمله.
body.en: `therefore` and `however` look the same on the page; choose only by meaning, not by the look of the sentence.
body.tr: Shekl-e neshane-gozari-ye `therefore` va `however` yeki ast; faghat ba ma'na entekhab kon, na ba zaher-e jomle.

body.fa: اگر نتیجه پیش از علت آمده باشد (`We need solar power; fossil fuels are running out.`)، `therefore` جا نمی‌شود؛ آنجا `because` لازم است.
body.en: If the result comes before the cause (`We need solar power; fossil fuels are running out.`), `therefore` does not fit; that needs `because`.
body.tr: Agar natije pish az ellat amade bashad (`We need solar power; fossil fuels are running out.`), `therefore` ja nemishavad; anja `because` lazem ast.

title.fa: مرور مجهول: حال، آینده و حال کامل
title.en: Passive review: present, future and present perfect
title.tr: Moroor-e majhool: hal, ayande va hal-e kamel

summary.fa: سه زمان، یک قالب: فقط `be` عوض می‌شود.
summary.en: Three tenses, one recipe: only `be` changes.
summary.tr: Se zaman, yek ghaleb: faghat `be` avaz mishavad.

title.fa: اول بفهم: همان بازیگر، لباس تازه
title.en: Understand first: the same actor, new clothes
title.tr: Avval befahm: haman bazigar, lebas-e taze

body.fa: درس سه همان مجهول درس‌های یک و دو را در موضوع انرژی مرور می‌کند. یادت هست: `be` لباس زمان را می‌پوشد و قسمت سوم فعل ثابت می‌ماند. `Wind turbines are used today` (حال ساده)، `Clean fuels will be used in the coming decades` (آینده)، `Many solar plants have been built recently` (حال کامل). سرنخ هر زمان را در جمله پیدا کن: `today`، `in the coming decades`، `recently`.
body.en: Lesson 3 reviews the passive of Lessons 1 and 2 in the energy topic. Remember: `be` wears the clothes of the tense, and the past participle stays the same. `Wind turbines are used today` (simple present), `Clean fuels will be used in the coming decades` (future), `Many solar plants have been built recently` (present perfect). Find each tense's clue in the sentence: `today`, `in the coming decades`, `recently`.
body.tr: Dars-e se haman majhool-e dars-haye yek va do ra dar mozoo'-e enerzhi moroor mikonad. Yadat hast: `be` lebas-e zaman ra mipooshad va ghesmat-e sevvom-e fe'l sabet mimanad. `Wind turbines are used today` (hal-e sade), `Clean fuels will be used in the coming decades` (ayande), `Many solar plants have been built recently` (hal-e kamel). Sarnakh-e har zaman ra dar jomle peyda kon: `today`, `in the coming decades`, `recently`.

blocks.art:
clue word          passive
 ---------------    ---------------
 today, usually     am/is/are + V3
 next, coming       will be + V3
 recently, already  has/have been
                    + V3

 are used / will be used /
 have been built

caption.fa: سرنخ زمان در ستون چپ، شکل مجهول در ستون راست.
caption.en: The time clue on the left, the passive form on the right.
caption.tr: Sarnakh-e zaman dar sotoon-e chap, shekl-e majhool dar sotoon-e rast.

title.fa: فعل داخل پرانتز
title.en: The verb in brackets
title.tr: Fe'l-e dakhel-e parantez

body.fa: در سؤال‌هایی که فعل داخل پرانتز داده شده (`build`)، دو کار لازم است: `be` درست را بساز و فعل را به قسمت سوم ببر. `build` بی‌قاعده است: `built`. فاعل جمع (`plants`) یعنی `have`، نه `has`.
body.en: In questions that give the verb in brackets (`build`), two jobs are needed: build the right `be` and turn the verb into its past participle. `build` is irregular: `built`. A plural subject (`plants`) means `have`, not `has`.
body.tr: Dar so'al-hayi ke fe'l-e dakhel-e parantez dade shode (`build`), do kar lazem ast: `be`-ye dorost ra besaz va fe'l ra be ghesmat-e sevvom bebar. `build` bi-ghaede ast: `built`. Fa'el-e jam' (`plants`) ya'ni `have`, na `has`.

blocks.math: am / is / are + V3 ,   will be + V3 ,   has / have been + V3

title.fa: گرم کردن: با مجهول حال ساده پر کن: `Today, wind turbines ___ in many countries to generate clean electricity.` (آزمون دی ۱۴۰۰)
title.en: Warm-up: complete with the simple present passive: `Today, wind turbines ___ in many countries to generate clean electricity.` (Dey 1400 paper)
title.tr: Garm kardan: ba majhool-e hal-e sade por kon: `Today, wind turbines ___ in many countries to generate clean electricity.` (azmoon-e Dey 1400)

text.fa: `Today` یعنی حال ساده؛ `turbines` جمع است، پس `are`.
text.en: `Today` means the simple present; `turbines` is plural, so `are`.
text.tr: `Today` ya'ni hal-e sade; `turbines` jam' ast, pas `are`.

title.fa: مسئلهٔ کتاب و امتحان: با مجهول آینده پر کن: `Clean fuels and energy resources ___ more widely by industries in the coming decades.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Textbook and exam: complete with the future passive: `Clean fuels and energy resources ___ more widely by industries in the coming decades.` (Khordad 1401 paper)
title.tr: Mas'ale-ye ketab va emtehan: ba majhool-e ayande por kon: `Clean fuels and energy resources ___ more widely by industries in the coming decades.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1401)

text.fa: `in the coming decades` سرنخ آینده و `by industries` سرنخ مجهول است.
text.en: `in the coming decades` is the future clue and `by industries` the passive clue.
text.tr: `in the coming decades` sarnakh-e ayande va `by industries` sarnakh-e majhool ast.

title.fa: پیچ امتحانی: شکل حال کامل مجهول فعل داخل پرانتز را بنویس: `Many solar power plants ___ (build) in desert areas recently.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۳۹۷)
title.en: Exam twist: write the present perfect passive of the verb in brackets: `Many solar power plants ___ (build) in desert areas recently.` (Khordad 1397 paper)
title.tr: Pich-e emtehani: shekl-e hal-e kamel-e majhool-e fe'l-e dakhel-e parantez ra benevis: `Many solar power plants ___ (build) in desert areas recently.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1397)

text.fa: پیچ امتحان: سه کار در یک جای خالی: `have` (فاعل جمع)، `been` (مجهول) و قسمت سوم بی‌قاعدهٔ `build`.
text.en: The twist: three jobs in one gap: `have` (plural subject), `been` (passive) and the irregular past participle of `build`.
text.tr: Pich-e emtehan: se kar dar yek ja-ye khali: `have` (fa'el-e jam'), `been` (majhool) va ghesmat-e sevvom-e bi-ghaede-ye `build`.

body.fa: `has been built` برای `plants` غلط است؛ فاعل جمع `have` می‌گیرد.
body.en: `has been built` is wrong for `plants`; a plural subject takes `have`.
body.tr: `has been built` baraye `plants` ghalat ast; fa'el-e jam' `have` migirad.

body.fa: فعل داخل پرانتز را به شکل ساده رها نکن: `have been build` نمره ندارد؛ `built`.
body.en: Do not leave the bracketed verb in its base form: `have been build` earns nothing; `built`.
body.tr: Fe'l-e dakhel-e parantez ra be shekl-e sade raha nakon: `have been build` nomre nadarad; `built`.

title.fa: اسم مصدر در نقش فاعل؛ صفت با مصدر
title.en: The gerund as subject; adjective + to-infinitive
title.tr: Esm-e masdar dar naghsh-e fa'el; sefat ba masdar

summary.fa: یک کار می‌تواند خودش فاعل جمله باشد: «بریدن درختان» نابود می‌کند.
summary.en: An action can itself be the subject: "cutting trees" destroys.
summary.tr: Yek kar mitavanad khodash fa'el-e jomle bashad: "boridan-e derakhtan" naboood mikonad.

title.fa: اول بفهم: کار، قهرمان جمله
title.en: Understand first: the action as the hero
title.tr: Avval befahm: kar, ghahreman-e jomle

body.fa: گاهی «یک کار» قهرمان جمله است، نه یک نفر یا یک چیز: «بریدن درختان زیستگاه‌ها را نابود می‌کند.» در انگلیسی، کار وقتی فاعل جمله می‌شود شکل `-ing` می‌گیرد و مثل یک اسم رفتار می‌کند: `Cutting down trees can destroy habitats.` فعل اصلی هم با آن مثل یک اسم مفرد جور می‌شود.
body.en: Sometimes "an action" is the hero of the sentence, not a person or a thing: "cutting down trees destroys habitats." In English, when an action becomes the subject it takes the `-ing` form and behaves like a noun: `Cutting down trees can destroy habitats.` The main verb agrees with it like a singular noun.
body.tr: Gahi "yek kar" ghahreman-e jomle ast, na yek nafar ya yek chiz: "boridan-e derakhtan zistgah-ha ra naboood mikonad." Dar engelisi, kar vaghti fa'el-e jomle mishavad shekl-e `-ing` migirad va mesl-e yek esm raftar mikonad: `Cutting down trees can destroy habitats.` Fe'l-e asli ham ba an mesl-e yek esm-e mofrad joor mishavad.

blocks.art:
V-ing as SUBJECT (start):
 [Cutting down trees] can destroy
       habitats.

 It is + ADJ + to V1:
 It is important [to use]
       clean energy.
 It is easy / necessary / hard
       + to V1

caption.fa: اول جمله، کار با `-ing`؛ بعد از `It is` و صفت، مصدر با `to`.
caption.en: At the start, the action takes `-ing`; after `It is` and an adjective, the infinitive with `to`.
caption.tr: Avval-e jomle, kar ba `-ing`; ba'd az `It is` va sefat, masdar ba `to`.

title.fa: الگوی دوم: صفت و مصدر
title.en: The second pattern: adjective and infinitive
title.tr: Olgoo-ye dovvom: sefat va masdar

body.fa: الگوی دوم: `It is` به‌اضافهٔ صفت (`important`، `necessary`، `easy`) و بعد مصدر با `to`: `It is important to use clean energy.` اینجا `It` فقط جای خالی را پر می‌کند و فاعل واقعی همان `to use clean energy` است. پس دو الگو: کار اول جمله با `-ing`، یا `It is` و صفت و `to`.
body.en: The second pattern: `It is` plus an adjective (`important`, `necessary`, `easy`), then the infinitive with `to`: `It is important to use clean energy.` Here `It` just fills the subject slot; the real subject is `to use clean energy`. So two patterns: the action at the start with `-ing`, or `It is` plus adjective plus `to`.
body.tr: Olgoo-ye dovvom: `It is` be-ezafe-ye sefat (`important`, `necessary`, `easy`) va ba'd masdar ba `to`: `It is important to use clean energy.` Inja `It` faghat ja-ye khali ra por mikonad va fa'el-e vaghe'i haman `to use clean energy` ast. Pas do olgoo: kar avval-e jomle ba `-ing`, ya `It is` va sefat va `to`.

blocks.math: V-ing ... + verb ...     It is + adj + to + V1

caption.en: Two patterns for an "action" in the sentence

title.fa: گرم کردن: شکل درست را بنویس: `___ down trees for industrial goals can destroy the natural habitats of animals.` (آزمون دی ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Warm-up: write the right form: `___ down trees for industrial goals can destroy the natural habitats of animals.` (Dey 1401 paper)
title.tr: Garm kardan: shekl-e dorost ra benevis: `___ down trees for industrial goals can destroy the natural habitats of animals.` (azmoon-e Dey 1401)

text.fa: جای خالی اول جمله است و یک «کار» (`cut down`) فاعل است؛ پس `-ing`.
text.en: The gap starts the sentence and an "action" (`cut down`) is the subject; so `-ing`.
text.tr: Ja-ye khali avval-e jomle ast va yek "kar" (`cut down`) fa'el ast; pas `-ing`.

title.fa: مسئلهٔ کتاب و امتحان: شکل درست را بنویس: `It is important ___ clean energy resources to save our planet from pollution.` (آزمون دی ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Textbook and exam: write the right form: `It is important ___ clean energy resources to save our planet from pollution.` (Dey 1401 paper)
title.tr: Mas'ale-ye ketab va emtehan: shekl-e dorost ra benevis: `It is important ___ clean energy resources to save our planet from pollution.` (azmoon-e Dey 1401)

text.fa: الگوی `It is` و صفت (`important`)؛ پشتش مصدر با `to` و فعل ساده.
text.en: The pattern `It is` plus an adjective (`important`); after it the infinitive with `to` and the base verb.
text.tr: Olgoo-ye `It is` va sefat (`important`); poshtash masdar ba `to` va fe'l-e sade.

title.fa: پیچ امتحانی: این جمله را با الگوی دیگر بازنویسی کن: `Using solar power is important.`
title.en: Exam twist: rewrite the sentence with the other pattern: `Using solar power is important.`
title.tr: Pich-e emtehani: jomle ra ba olgoo-ye digar baz-nevisi kon: `Using solar power is important.`

text.fa: پیچ امتحان: دو الگو یک معنا دارند. فاعل `-ing` را آخر ببر و به مصدر با `to` تبدیل کن؛ جای خالی اول را `It` پر می‌کند.
text.en: The twist: the two patterns mean the same. Move the `-ing` subject to the end as a `to` infinitive; `It` fills the empty front slot.
text.tr: Pich-e emtehan: do olgoo yek ma'na darand. Fa'el-e `-ing` ra akhar bebar va be masdar ba `to` tabdil kon; ja-ye khali-ye avval ra `It` por mikonad.

steps.math: Using solar power is important  →  It is important to use solar power

answer.fa: `It is important to use solar power.`
answer.en: `It is important to use solar power.`
answer.tr: `It is important to use solar power.`

body.fa: فاعلِ کار را با شکل ساده شروع نکن: `Cut down trees can destroy...` غلط است؛ `Cutting`.
body.en: Do not start an action subject with the base form: `Cut down trees can destroy...` is wrong; `Cutting`.
body.tr: Fa'el-e kar ra ba shekl-e sade shoru' nakon: `Cut down trees can destroy...` ghalat ast; `Cutting`.

body.fa: حرف آخر `cut` دوبار می‌شود: `cutting`، نه `cuting`؛ مثل `running` و `stopping`.
body.en: The last letter of `cut` doubles: `cutting`, not `cuting`; like `running` and `stopping`.
body.tr: Harf-e akhar-e `cut` do-bar mishavad: `cutting`, na `cuting`; mesl-e `running` va `stopping`.

title.fa: واژگان انرژی تجدیدپذیر
title.en: Renewable-energy vocabulary
title.tr: Vazhegan-e enerzhi-ye tajdid-pazir

summary.fa: دو خانواده: انرژی‌هایی که هرگز تمام نمی‌شوند و سوخت‌هایی که تمام می‌شوند.
summary.en: Two families: energy that never runs out, and fuels that do.
summary.tr: Do khanevade: enerzhi-hayi ke hargez tamam nemishavand va sookht-hayi ke tamam mishavand.

title.fa: اول بفهم: چشمه یا قوطی کنسرو
title.en: Understand first: a spring or a tin
title.tr: Avval befahm: cheshme ya ghooti konserv

body.fa: واژه‌های این درس را در دو ستون بچین. ستون اول، انرژی‌های `renewable` (تجدیدپذیر): باد، خورشید و آب، که مثل چشمه هرگز خشک نمی‌شوند و `emissions` (گاز خروجی) ندارند. ستون دوم، سوخت‌های `fossil` (فسیلی): زغال‌سنگ، نفت و گاز، که مثل یک قوطی کنسرو تمام می‌شوند (`deplete`)، میلیون‌ها سال طول می‌کشد تا بسازند و هوا را `pollute` (آلوده) می‌کنند. هر جای خالی را اول به یکی از این دو ستون ببر.
body.en: Arrange this lesson's words in two columns. Column one, `renewable` energy: wind, sun and water, which like a spring never run dry and produce no `emissions`. Column two, `fossil` fuels: coal, oil and gas, which run out like a tin of food (`deplete`), take millions of years to form, and `pollute` the air. Put every gap into one of these two columns first.
body.tr: Vazhe-haye in dars ra dar do sotoon bechin. Sotoon-e avval, enerzhi-haye `renewable` (tajdid-pazir): bad, khorshid va ab, ke mesl-e cheshme hargez khoshk nemishavand va `emissions` (gaz-e khorooji) nadarand. Sotoon-e dovvom, sookht-haye `fossil` (fosili): zoghal-sang, naft va gaz, ke mesl-e yek ghooti konserv tamam mishavand (`deplete`), milyon-ha sal tool mikeshad ta besazand va hava ra `pollute` (aloode) mikonand. Har ja-ye khali ra avval be yeki az in do sotoon bebar.

blocks.art:
RENEWABLE        NON-RENEWABLE
 (never ends)     (runs out)
 ------------     -------------
 wind, sun,       coal, oil, gas
 water            = FOSSIL FUELS
 clean SOURCES    millions of yrs
 no EMISSIONS     POLLUTE the air
 KINETIC energy   DEPLETE resources
 of wind          POLLUTION

caption.fa: هر واژه را در ستون درست بگذار؛ جای خالی معمولاً از روی ستونش پیدا می‌شود.
caption.en: Put each word in its column; a gap is usually found from its column.
caption.tr: Har vazhe ra dar sotoon-e dorost begozar; ja-ye khali ma'moolan az rooye sotoonash peyda mishavad.

title.fa: فعل یا اسم؟
title.en: Verb or noun?
title.tr: Fe'l ya esm?

body.fa: خانواده‌های فعل و اسم را هم جدا کن: `pollute` (آلوده کردن، فعل) و `pollution` (آلودگی، اسم)؛ `emit` (بیرون دادن) و `emissions` (گازهای خروجی). بعد از `do not` فعل می‌آید (`do not pollute the air`) و بعد از `heavy` اسم (`heavy pollution`). واژه‌های دیگر: `kinetic` (جنبشی، انرژی حرکت باد)، `provide` (فراهم کردن)، `environment` (محیط زیست)، `sources` (منابع).
body.en: Separate the verb and noun families too: `pollute` (verb) and `pollution` (noun); `emit` (to send out) and `emissions` (the gases sent out). After `do not` comes a verb (`do not pollute the air`) and after `heavy` a noun (`heavy pollution`). Other words: `kinetic` (the energy of the wind's movement), `provide` (to supply), `environment`, `sources`.
body.tr: Khanevade-haye fe'l va esm ra ham joda kon: `pollute` (aloode kardan, fe'l) va `pollution` (aloodegi, esm); `emit` (biroon dadan) va `emissions` (gaz-haye khorooji). Ba'd az `do not` fe'l miayad (`do not pollute the air`) va ba'd az `heavy` esm (`heavy pollution`). Vazhe-haye digar: `kinetic` (jonbeshi, enerzhi-ye harekat-e bad), `provide` (faraham kardan), `environment` (mohit-e zist), `sources` (manabe').

blocks.math: renewable ≠ fossil ,   pollute (v) → pollution (n) ,   emit (v) → emissions (n)

caption.fa: دو ستون و دو خانوادهٔ واژه
caption.en: Two columns and two word families
caption.tr: Do sotoon va do khanevade-ye vazhe

title.fa: گرم کردن: واژهٔ تعریف‌شده را بنویس: `Resources like wind and sunlight that are never finished or used up completely are called ___ energy.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Warm-up: write the word defined: `Resources like wind and sunlight that are never finished or used up completely are called ___ energy.` (Khordad 1401 paper)
title.tr: Garm kardan: vazhe-ye ta'rif-shode ra benevis: `Resources like wind and sunlight that are never finished or used up completely are called ___ energy.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1401)

text.fa: `never finished` یعنی ستون چشمه: انرژی‌ای که هرگز تمام نمی‌شود.
text.en: `never finished` means the spring column: energy that never runs out.
text.tr: `never finished` ya'ni sotoon-e cheshme: enerzhi-i ke hargez tamam nemishavad.

title.fa: مسئلهٔ کتاب و امتحان: واژهٔ درست را بنویس: `Coal, oil, and natural gas are non-renewable resources that are called ___ fuels.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Textbook and exam: write the right word: `Coal, oil, and natural gas are non-renewable resources that are called ___ fuels.` (Khordad 1401 paper)
title.tr: Mas'ale-ye ketab va emtehan: vazhe-ye dorost ra benevis: `Coal, oil, and natural gas are non-renewable resources that are called ___ fuels.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1401)

text.fa: زغال‌سنگ، نفت و گاز در ستون قوطی کنسرو‌اند و جفت همیشگی‌شان `fuels` است.
text.en: Coal, oil and gas are in the tin column, and their permanent partner is `fuels`.
text.tr: Zoghal-sang, naft va gaz dar sotoon-e ghooti konserv-and va joft-e hamishegi-shan `fuels` ast.

title.fa: پیچ امتحانی: واژهٔ درست را بنویس: `Solar panels and wind turbines are clean technologies that protect our environment from heavy ___.` (آزمون خرداد ۱۴۰۱)
title.en: Exam twist: write the right word: `Solar panels and wind turbines are clean technologies that protect our environment from heavy ___.` (Khordad 1401 paper)
title.tr: Pich-e emtehani: vazhe-ye dorost ra benevis: `Solar panels and wind turbines are clean technologies that protect our environment from heavy ___.` (azmoon-e Khordad 1401)

text.fa: پیچ امتحان: معنا «آلودگی» است و همه `pollute` را می‌شناسند، ولی بعد از `heavy` اسم لازم است، نه فعل.
text.en: The twist: the meaning is pollution and everyone knows `pollute`, but after `heavy` a noun is needed, not a verb.
text.tr: Pich-e emtehan: ma'na "aloodegi" ast va hame `pollute` ra mishenasand, vali ba'd az `heavy` esm lazem ast, na fe'l.

body.fa: `pollute` و `pollution` را جابه‌جا نکن: `do not pollute the air` (فعل) ولی `heavy pollution` (اسم).
body.en: Do not swap `pollute` and `pollution`: `do not pollute the air` (verb) but `heavy pollution` (noun).
body.tr: `pollute` va `pollution` ra jabeja nakon: `do not pollute the air` (fe'l) vali `heavy pollution` (esm).

body.fa: `renewable` یعنی «تمام‌نشدنی»، نه فقط «تمیز»؛ نفت هرگز `renewable` نیست، حتی اگر کم مصرف شود.
body.en: `renewable` means "never running out", not just "clean"; oil is never `renewable`, even if used sparingly.
body.tr: `renewable` ya'ni "tamam-nashodani", na faghat "tamiz"; naft hargez `renewable` nist, hatta agar kam masraf shavad.
